_comment: The six playable creatures. `cell` is the picture's number in vendor/opengameart/tiny-creatures.png — 16x16 cells, 10 across, 18 down, so cell n sits at x = (n % 10) * 16, y = floor(n / 10) * 16. All six are real, friendly animals: no dragons, no demons, no merfolk. A creature carries no stat and no type: a duel is rock, paper, scissors, so your animal is a costume and nothing more (decision-log row 53).

_face: Where a creature's eyes are, in art pixels inside its own 16x16 cell — the middle of the eye band, read off the sheet rather than guessed. The six animals face different ways, so a cosmetic that sits ON a face (see data/cosmetics.json) has to be told where the face is; everything is drawn relative to this point.
